route.name: Search Result

parameters.order: Sort order, desc and asc (desc descending by default)

route.description:
| Sort options     | sort      |
| ---------------- | --------- |
| Best match       | bestmatch |
| Most stars       | stars     |
| Most forks       | forks     |
| Recently updated | updated   |

route.name: Topics

parameters.name: Topic name, which can be found in the URL of the corresponding [Topics Page](https://github.com/topics/framework)
parameters.qs: Query string, like `l=php&o=desc&s=stars`. Details listed as follows:

route.description:
| Parameter | Description      | Values                                                                                                                          |
| --------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `l`       | Language         | For instance `php`, which can be found in the URL of the corresponding [Topics page](https://github.com/topics/framework?l=php) |
| `o`       | Sorting Order    | `asc`, `desc`                                                                                                                   |
| `s`       | Sorting Criteria | `stars`, `forks`, `updated`                                                                                                     |

  For instance, the `/github/topics/framework/l=php&o=desc&s=stars` route will generate the RSS feed corresponding to this [page](https://github.com/topics/framework?l=php&o=desc&s=stars).

parameters.dirId: 公告分类, 可在页面URL获取 默认为全部

parameters.id: topic_id 主题 `id` 可在社区板块 URL 中找到
